foundation.beast_echo_marrow_v0_2A.gener.why: Gain Pack Echo (max 1, once a round, refreshing) after a Fixed Beast-Echo Scope hit while an ally or bonded companion is within 30 ft of you or the target, or after hitting a beast-aspected creature; it expires at the end of your next turn (combat/pressure.py owns the clocks; combat/ext/beast_echo_marrow.py generates both receipts, so the compiled generic own-hit reaction is claimed out instead of paying again).

foundation.beast_echo_marrow_v0_2A.pack_.why: Paid rider on a qualifying hit; combat/ext/beast_echo_marrow.py owns the spend, the damage of the hit's type, and the Refined Pack Marrow and Beast-Echo Marrow State riders.

foundation.beast_echo_marrow_v0_2A.beast.why: Spend 1 Pack Echo to add PB to a Fixed Beast-Echo Scope check or saving throw; combat/ext/beast_echo_marrow.py registers the d20_rewrite rule (and the Companion Echo companion-bond rule and its psychic-damage reroll).

foundation.beast_echo_marrow_v0_2A.marro.why: The plug-in's ownership row: the printed reaction (spend 1 Pack Echo when you, a bonded companion or an ally within 30 feet takes damage from a creature your side damaged since the start of your last turn, or from a beast, predator, natural-weapon, blood, fear or pack-aura source: reduce it by PB + your cultivation ability modifier; a bonded companion hit by a beast-aspected source may also move 5 feet without provoking) compiles as its own generic reaction from the typed record, which keeps compiling alongside this row. combat/ext/beast_echo_marrow.py owns the trigger filter (reaction_geometry_allowed), the +modifier (damage_reduction_bonus), the companion riders and the once-per-round pack budget.

foundation.beast_echo_marrow_v0_2A.compa.why: Refined rider on Marrow Pack Guard for a bonded companion and Beast-Sense Witness for a companion-bond save/check; combat/ext/beast_echo_marrow.py owns the another PB and the psychic-damage reroll.

foundation.beast_echo_marrow_v0_2A.pack_.why: Refined rider on Pack-Marrow Strike: another PB when the fighter damaged the same target since the start of the fighter's last turn (combat/ext/beast_echo_marrow.py).

foundation.beast_echo_marrow_v0_2A.preda.why: Refined rider on generating Pack Echo from a beast-aspected hit: temporary HP equal to PB or a 5-foot move without provoking (combat/ext/beast_echo_marrow.py; the player chooses, the AI takes the temporary HP).

foundation.beast_echo_marrow_v0_2A.beast.why: Bonus Action, 1 Pack Echo + 2 CP, once per combat or major scene: the one-minute state for the fighter and one bonded companion or ally within 60 ft (combat/ext/beast_echo_marrow.py owns the action, the pair's mode hooks and riders).
